name: [otel demo] ad service p95 latency above 50 ms (${ENV_NAME})
message: p95 latency on the ad service is above 50 ms (baseline about 2 ms). The scenarios pod turns adHighCpu on from :30 to :45 each hour, UTC; this monitor stays in alert for the whole window, where the anomaly monitor flags only the onset. No notification targets on purpose.
